def mergeSort(arr):
    
    if len(arr) > 1:
 
        mid = len(arr)//2
        Left = arr[:mid]
        Right = arr[mid:]
 
        mergeSort(Left)
        mergeSort(Right)
 
        i = j = k = 0
 
        while i < len(Left) and j < len(Right):
            if Left[i] < Right[j]:
                arr[k] = Left[i]
                i += 1
            else:
                arr[k] = Right[j]
                j += 1
            k += 1
 
        while i < len(Left):
            arr[k] = Left[i]
            i += 1
            k += 1
 
        while j < len(Right):
            arr[k] = Right[j]
            j += 1
            k += 1
    return arr
